literal: If they obtain a worthy husband, and if they act accordingly, wives will attain great glory in the world where the gods dwell.
translation: If wives obtain a worthy husband and live in true devotion to him, they will win great glory in the world where the gods dwell.
modern: பெண்கள் தகுதியான கணவனைப் பெற்று, அவனுக்கு ஏற்றவாறு அன்போடு வாழ்ந்தால், தேவர்கள் வாழும் மேலுலகத்தில் பெரும் சிறப்பினை அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate spiritual reward of a devoted wife. The word 'பெற்றால்' refers to obtaining a virtuous husband, while 'பெறின்' means living in a manner that honors and cherishes that relationship. If a woman achieves this harmonious domestic life, she is promised 'பெருஞ்சிறப்பு' (great glory) in 'புத்தேளிர் வாழும் உலகு' (the world where celestial beings dwell). The poet suggests that the quiet virtues of a dedicated household life elevate a woman to a status celebrated even in the divine realms.
